Of Transportation' as text; the title line 'STATE OF HAWAII DRIVER’S MANUAL' prints on the contents page (p7) and 'Hawaii Drivers’ Manual' on the back cover (p132), neither with an edition. Physical p2 (inside front cover, no printed folio) carries the copyright line naming the Director of Transportation, State of Hawaii and the imprint line 'HMG 5/2023' (Hagadone Media Group, May 2023), so per the load-bearing-edition rule the observation is taken on p2 with issuer + edition and no title observation.

passing_score.verbatim: A knowledge test relating to rules of the road and traffic control devices

exam_facts.note: Physical p12 (printed 12, PRELIMINARY EXAMINATIONS) lists the tests given when applying for a license or instruction permit: '1. A vision test', '2. A knowledge test relating to rules of the road and traffic control devices', '3. A practical road test', and says the knowledge and road tests may be waived for class 1 through 3 applicants holding a provisional or out-of-state license. Full-text searches across all 132 extracted pages for pass/percent/questions/correct/score/passing grade found no question count, passing score or percent, or time limit for the class 3 knowledge test (the only percentages are crash statistics and the trailer-load figure); nulls are genuine absences, never imported from memory. Note: this PDF's text layer also carries a superseded hidden layer on many pages (e.g. p12 hidden lines '1. Rules of the Road / 2. Vision / 3. Recognition of traffic control devices' and 'You must pass these tests before you are permitted to take the driver performance road test'), which is not visible when the page is rendered; the verbatim quoted here is the visible text.
